svg.title: Satellite Knot: Companion and Pattern
svg.desc: Left: a solid torus whose core is a dashed trefoil (the companion knot), with a thin blue curve (the pattern) winding inside the tube. Right: the resulting satellite knot drawn alone, surrounded by a dashed curve marking the incompressible torus, the JSJ wall separating the two layers.
svg.text: Satellite knot = pattern inside a knotted solid torus
